item.title: Amsterdam Exchange Bank (Wisselbank, 1609)
item.description: Amsterdam Exchange Bank (Wisselbank) The Amsterdamsche Wisselbank (Exchange Bank), founded in 1609, was the municipal bank of Amsterdam that transformed Dutch finance by providing reliable deposit, transfer, and currency-exchange services to merchants.
